content.text:
I implemented `slugify` in `src/strings.js` and added 10 tests for it in `test/strings.test.js`. `npm test` passes, 12 of 12 including the two existing `capitalize` tests.

It handles `đ`/`Đ` first, then strips diacritics and lowercases. Every run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one hyphen, and leading and trailing hyphens are trimmed. It then cuts to 50 characters and removes any trailing hyphen the cut leaves.

The tests cover:
- basic lowercasing and hyphenation
- Vietnamese text including `đ`
- other Latin diacritics
- collapsing runs of symbols
- trimming hyphens at the ends
- empty and symbol-only input
- digits
- truncation at 50 characters, including a cut that would otherwise end in a hyphen
- a slug of exactly 50 characters
